prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
A uniform BRIGHT CYAN-WHITE flat color field — think #D6EEF5, a
glaring very-pale cyan the color of a board-game "glacier/ice" tile.
Clearly COOL and faintly BLUE — visibly distinguishable from the
mint tundra tile (not green), and visibly distinguishable from
any beige/cream paper background (not yellow-cream, not neutral-
white). Saturated enough that the cyan tint reads immediately.
Fill the ENTIRE 1024x1024 square edge-to-edge with this one cyan-
white color corner to corner — NO drawn hex, NO paper border, NO
vignette, NO centered composition, NO cracks or ice features. Only
the faintest paint-texture variation within the same cyan-white hue.
A region-fill swatch, not a tile with a shape drawn on it.
formatted_prompt: Cartogram tile illustration, vivid game-map register, bold saturated flat color field filling the entire 1024x1024 square edge-to-edge with a single glaring pale cyan wash — the precise hue of a board-game glacier tile, bright cool cyan-white (#D6EEF5), clearly blue-tinted and distinct from any mint or cream. The entire frame is one continuous cool cyan-white color plane with only the faintest brushstroke texture variation within the same icy hue — no cracks, no features, no shapes, no borders, no vignette, no centered composition. Punchy, unambiguous, immediately readable as ice terrain against tundra or ocean tiles. Confident ink register, fresh saturated fill, zero aging or neutralization.
